jp-20260830-news-1.title: Mizuho Securities Becomes the Only Japanese Lead Underwriter for SpaceX IPO: Behind the Scenes of Selling Out Approximately 350 Billion Yen Using "POWL"

segments.src: ## 米宇宙企業の巨大新規株式公開、日本勢で唯一参画
segments.tr: ## Massive IPO of a U.S. Space Company, the Only Japanese Participant

segments.src: 米宇宙開発企業スペースXが実施した大型の新規株式公開(IPO)において、みずほ証券が日本の証券会社として唯一、グローバルな引受幹事団に名を連ねたことが話題を集めています。同社は国内の個人投資家・機関投資家向けに割り当てられた株式、総額でおよそ3500億円分を、募集開始からわずか半日足らずで完売させたと伝えられています。
segments.tr: Mizuho Securities has garnered attention for being the only Japanese securities firm to join the global underwriting syndicate for the large-scale initial public offering (IPO) conducted by the U.S. space development company SpaceX. It is reported that the firm sold out the total allocation of approximately 350 billion yen for individual and institutional investors in Japan in less than half a day after the offering began.

segments.src: 海外の未上場優良企業への投資機会は、これまで機関投資家や富裕層向けファンドに限られるケースが多く、日本の個人投資家が直接アクセスすることは容易ではありませんでした。今回のケースは、その構図に一石を投じるものとして注目されています。
segments.tr: Investment opportunities in high-quality, unlisted overseas companies have often been limited to institutional investors and funds for wealthy individuals, making it difficult for individual investors in Japan to access them directly. This case is attracting attention as a development that challenges that status quo.

segments.src: ## カギを握った「POWL」という仕組み
segments.tr: ## The Mechanism That Held the Key: "POWL"

segments.src: 今回の完売劇を支えたのが「POWL(Public Offering Without Listing、私募的展開)」と呼ばれる制度です。これは、海外で上場する株式を国内の投資家に対して勧誘・販売する際に用いられる枠組みで、通常の公募よりも柔軟かつ迅速な形で株式を配分できる点が特徴とされています。
segments.tr: The mechanism that supported this sell-out was a system called "POWL" (Public Offering Without Listing). This is a framework used when soliciting and selling shares listed overseas to domestic investors, characterized by the ability to allocate shares more flexibly and quickly than in a standard public offering.

segments.src: みずほ証券はこのPOWLの仕組みを活用することで、国内の販売網を通じて短期間のうちに投資家への情報提供と申込受付を完了させたとみられます。詳細な配分基準や販売プロセスについては各社の公表資料を確認する必要がありますが、大規模かつタイトなスケジュールの案件を国内で消化しきった点は、証券業界内でも実務的な成功例として語られています。
segments.tr: By utilizing this POWL mechanism, Mizuho Securities appears to have completed the provision of information to investors and the acceptance of applications within a short period through its domestic sales network. While it is necessary to check the public disclosures of each company for detailed allocation criteria and sales processes, the fact that they successfully handled a large-scale, tight-schedule project domestically is being discussed within the securities industry as a practical success story.

segments.src: ## 楽天証券・SBI証券との連携という新しい形
segments.tr: ## A New Form of Collaboration with Rakuten Securities and SBI Securities

segments.src: もう一つの注目点は、みずほ証券が主幹事を務めつつも、楽天証券やSBI証券といったオンライン証券大手と連携し、販売チャネルを広げたとされることです。伝統的な対面証券と、個人投資家に強いネット証券が協力する形は、幅広い投資家層への迅速なリーチを可能にした要因の一つと考えられます。
segments.tr: Another point of interest is that while Mizuho Securities served as the lead underwriter, it collaborated with major online securities firms such as Rakuten Securities and SBI Securities to expand its sales channels. This form of cooperation between traditional face-to-face securities firms and online securities firms, which are strong with individual investors, is considered one of the factors that enabled rapid reach to a wide range of investors.

segments.src: こうした協業モデルは、今後も大型の海外案件が国内に持ち込まれる際の一つのひな型となる可能性があり、証券業界の販売戦略の変化を示す事例として関心を集めています。
segments.tr: Such a collaboration model has the potential to become a template for when large-scale overseas projects are brought to Japan in the future, and it is attracting interest as a case study indicating changes in the sales strategies of the securities industry.

segments.src: ## 個人投資家が押さえておきたいポイント
segments.tr: ## Key Points for Individual Investors to Keep in Mind

segments.src: 今回のような未上場企業株式やIPO関連商品への投資は、通常の上場株式とは異なるリスク特性を持つ点に注意が必要です。
segments.tr: It is important to note that investments in unlisted company shares or IPO-related products like this have different risk characteristics than standard listed stocks.

segments.src: - 上場前の企業は情報開示の範囲や頻度が限定的な場合がある
segments.tr: - The scope and frequency of information disclosure for pre-IPO companies may be limited

segments.src: - 想定通りの上場・値動きが実現するとは限らない
segments.tr: - The expected listing and price movements may not materialize as anticipated

segments.src: - 為替変動の影響を受ける外貨建て資産である
segments.tr: - These are foreign currency-denominated assets subject to exchange rate fluctuations

segments.src: - 販売数量に制限があり、希望通りに購入できるとは限らない
segments.tr: - There are limits on the quantity available for sale, and you may not be able to purchase as much as you wish

segments.src: 本記事は報道されている事実関係の紹介を目的としたものであり、特定の金融商品への投資を推奨するものではありません。実際の申込条件、手数料、リスク説明については、各証券会社が提供する公式の目論見書や交付資料を必ず確認し、必要に応じて専門家に相談したうえで、ご自身の判断と責任で投資判断を行ってください。
segments.tr: This article is intended to introduce reported facts and does not recommend investment in any specific financial product. For actual application conditions, fees, and risk explanations, please be sure to check the official prospectus and delivery documents provided by each securities company, consult with a professional if necessary, and make investment decisions based on your own judgment and responsibility.

segments.src: ## 今後の展開への注目点
segments.tr: ## Points to Watch for Future Developments

segments.src: 今回の事例は、日本の証券会社が海外の大型IPO案件においてどのような役割を果たせるかを示す一つの試金石とも言えます。今後、同様の枠組みを使った海外企業の株式提供が増えるのか、また個人投資家がこうした機会にどうアクセスしていくのかは、引き続き市場関係者の注目を集めそうです。
segments.tr: This case can be seen as a litmus test for the role that Japanese securities firms can play in large-scale overseas IPO projects. Whether the provision of shares in overseas companies using similar frameworks will increase in the future, and how individual investors will access such opportunities, will likely continue to attract the attention of market participants.
